replies.text:
Barramundi22 Does anyone have tips for finding a cyber security expert? Not for a company but for a individual being targeted.

Maybe ask some small companies who they use? Perhaps ask your attorney for advice on finding a security expert? Many security intrusions are illegal, so having an attorney may well be a necessity.
